limits: Both complete hosted test families request Node 20.19.x in the exact-source workflows; the collector does not report the resolved patch runtime, so this is not a two-runtime matrix or a runtime-version observation.
The frozen artifact was byte/hash/Git/inventory inspected, but this package did not execute the frozen artifact in a browser or perform deployed offline acceptance.
The source-bound browser evidence is pre-release evidence only; it does not establish public v0.78.0 release or GitHub Pages acceptance.
No physical hardware, controller, touch, screen-reader, latency, memory, audible listening, full-track review, transition review, loop-seam review, mix approval, or Content ID clearance is claimed.
The zero-skip derivative fixture uses opaque OGG provenance bytes and a structurally inspected MP3 runtime; it does not decode OGG or prove a real audio conversion.

The frozen v0.78.0 payload contains the rights-aware soundtrack v3 framework but zero approved licensed recordings, zero built-in original recordings, zero optional soundtrack albums, and no optional soundtrack audio bytes.
The separate 70-track preview archive and its fifteen .rlsound packs are external publication evidence and are not frozen v0.78.0 game payloads.
Tag creation, release publication, original uploads, and deployed acceptance remain separate operations.

The merge has ordered parents base then exact source, an identical source/merge tree, and an empty source-to-merge diff; the release payload remains bound to the exact qualified source commit and tree.
